news_summary: Indiaspora warned in an October 30 statement that targeting H-1B holders could have very serious consequences for communities across the United States, and urged leaders to reject anti-Indian rhetoric ahead of the midterms.
payoff: The $100,000 payment and wage-weighted selection already apply; the other measures Indiaspora opposes would each need their own rule or law before they bite.
